essential_conclusion: For a cardinality-minimal width-three counterexample with a proper autonomous chain M={c1<...<cm}, deleting only the top x=cm preserves width exactly three and connected incomparability. Uniform extensions of P project to uniform extensions of P-x with exact fiber 1+s, where s counts neutral elements between c_{m-1} and the first upper-boundary element. Hence every old-pair defect is affine: Delta Pr(A)=Cov(s,1_A)/(1+E s), and for outside-only events the consecutive binomial-weight ratio is (m+r)/m. It therefore suffices to prove the one-step migration lemma: either some balanced pair of P-x survives or the new top x has a balanced incomparable pair. Finite exact stress through naturally labelled quotient size 6 and m=2,3 found 0 failures among 43,530 retained antecedent-balanced cases; this is evidence only, not closure.
first_missing_implication: Prove the boundary-active one-step autonomous inflation lemma using width(N)<=2 and the exact boundary-covariance decomposition s=sum_z 1{c<z<all U}; if all old balanced pairs cross an endpoint under the (s+1)-size bias, force a balanced pair involving the new top x.
